Prohibits account activation pending resolution of flagged issues.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.
Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.
